14/S0.subgoal: Describe the various non-hand input methods used in VR, including full-body tracking and sound-based tracking.

14/S1.subgoal: Explain the role of the processing unit and its key components, such as the GPU, CPU, and RAM.

14/S2.subgoal: Identify and describe the different types of visual displays, such as HMDs, world-fixed displays, and regular displays.

14/S3.subgoal: Describe the various non-visual output devices, including audio, haptics, motion platforms, and treadmills.

14/S4.subgoal: Summarize the hardware components used to generate VR experiences.
